propositions: Operators lack an on-demand, non-blocking way to verify that mapped project keys and legacy_default in projects.json are visible to the bot outside a full reconcile pass.

The bridge fsck command needs an opt-in --live-visibility flag that performs a read-only advisory live mapped-key/legacy_default visibility check against Jira credentials without mutating bridge state or altering exit contract.
The visibility check must gracefully degrade when JIRA_URL/JIRA_USER/JIRA_API_TOKEN credentials are absent, emitting a skipped advisory status without calling the probe or failing the command.
The new visibility step must reuse the shared helper check_mapped_project_visibility from access_check.py (used by ticket D's reconcile preflight) to eliminate duplicate existence-check logic.
Core rebar doctor command must remain Jira-free with no reconciler or agents import reachable from _commands/doctor.py; the visibility feature lives only on the bridge surface.
The default bridge fsck stdout JSON schema and contract (unknown_event_types, binding_drift, store_integrity) must remain unchanged; the advisory is rendered to stderr only.
